glosses: An expression of surprise.

glosses: An exclamation of ooh.

An expression of one's own physical pain.

examples.text: Ouch! You stepped on my toe! That hurt!

glosses: An expression in sympathy at another's pain.

examples.text: Ouch! Her sunburn looks awful.

glosses: A reply to an insult seen as savage (frequently one that is tongue-in-cheek or joking).

examples.text: Ouch. How could you say that?

glosses: An expression of disappointment.

examples.text: Ouch, I really wanted to do that.

glosses: Expressing surprise at the high price of something.

examples.text: Ouch, one hundred thousand dollars for a car! I could never afford that!

examples.text: RhuliGel soothes the itches and ouches of summer.
